summary: Step 2 Refinement frontend testing - all major features verified passing. Minor issue: Forgot Something 'Done' button uses router.back() which fails when navigating directly to /forgot URL (no back stack), but in normal app flow (pushed from Home) this would work correctly.

integration_issues.issue: When /forgot is opened via direct URL (no prior navigation stack), router.back() logs 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator'. In normal app flow (navigating from Home), this is not an issue. Low risk for production.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) - minor console warning only

action_items: Consider replacing pointerEvents prop on Animated.View in Toast.tsx with style.pointerEvents to fix deprecation warning
